title: Venezuelan Tacos
description: A flavorful twist on traditional tacos, featuring roasted Venezuelan-style beef and topped with fresh leaves and a hint of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: aromatic spices
ingredients.notes: such as cumin and chili powder

ingredients.name: roasted peppers
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers or poblano

ingredients.name: venezuelan cheese
ingredients.notes: such as queso fresco or mozzarella

ingredients.name: vine-ripened tomatoes
ingredients.notes: such as cherry or grape tomatoes

ingredients.name: tortillas
ingredients.notes: such as flour or corn tortillas

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Season the flank steak with aromatic spices and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, roast the peppers in a dry skillet over medium heat until charred, about 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by slicing the cooked steak and placing it onto a warmed tortilla.
Top with roasted peppers, venezuelan cheese, vine-ripened tomatoes, and tacos leaves.
Serve with a dollop of vegan sour cream and enjoy!
